scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The result applies to a centered interval and strict time–bandwidth product \(0<BT<1\) only.
The optimal coefficient is sharp as a uniform constant by a limiting two-packet construction; nonzero equality attainment is not claimed.
The phase-distance estimate is derived from the main inequality and is not asserted to have an optimal constant.
The first public date is taken from the v1 submission date of arXiv:2307.04558, not its later revision date.
Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
title: A sharp phase-deficit bound for Paley–Wiener symmetrization
